messages:
Maya (partnerships): Quick sync — CloudForge x SI One joint webinar next Wed 9am PT. Need final speaker confirmations, demo runbook, and swag shipping cutoffs. CloudForge wants a live demo using Dedicated GPUs; SI One will show their integration pipeline. Who's on backup? Slides + final demo script due Mon EOD.
Jonah (events): I can own run-of-show + host dress rehearsal Tues 11am PT. @Priya can you confirm SI One deck + who from SI will present? :calendar:
Priya (solutions): SI One confirmed 2 presenters (Raj + Mei). I'll get the deck and demo script by Mon 3pm PT. We'll include a fallback: pre-recorded screen capture of the integration flow. :white_check_mark:
Alex (eng-runtime): For the live demo, let's lock the model to `rdx-infer-v2-quantized` on Dedicated to avoid out-of-quota surprises. Also recommend throttling tokens + limit to 3 responses per session. If latency spikes, fallback to the recorded clip.
DevOps Bot: staging-deploy: inference cluster for webinar environment deployed at https://staging-webinar.redwood.ai — routing rule created for cloudforge-demo.
Maya (partnerships): Shipping cutoff for swag: Friday 3pm PST (to hit customs & venue). Lina, can you handle courier and customs paperwork? Also need 2x speaker kits to arrive day-before. Proposal: 250 attendee kits, 50 partner kits, 5 on-site spares.
Lina (logistics): Yep — I got the vendor contact. I'll raise PO today. Plan: FedEx Intl Priority for EU shipments (CN labels for customs). ETA domestic 2 day. I'll send tracking spreadsheet by EOD.
Jonah (events): Run-of-show draft (Tues rehearsal will iterate):
```
08:45 doors open / lobby
09:00 host intro (Maya) 5m
09:05 CloudForge keynote 10m
09:15 Live demo (CloudForge + Redwood) 18m
09:33 SI One integration walkthrough 12m
09:45 Q&A 10m
09:55 close 5m
```
Fallback: at +33m switch to pre-recorded demo, move to Q&A early.
Priya (solutions): For recordings — SI One requires 30 day retention and shared copy for their records. We should confirm consent form before the show. I'll draft it.
Alex (eng-runtime): Can someone add a short healthcheck to the demo script: `curl -sS https://staging-webinar.redwood.ai/health | jq .status` — if not OK, flip to recording.
Maya (partnerships): Great. Action items: Jonah run rehearsal invite; Priya get slides + consent; Lina ship swag + PO; Alex add healthcheck; I'll confirm speaker bios + headshots by Fri. Tagging @channel for awareness. :mailbox_with_mail:
Jonah (events): Added rehearsal invite. See calendar. :thumbsup:
Lina (logistics): Tracking sheet shared: https://tiny.redwood/swag-tracking — I listed courier options and customs notes.
Maya (partnerships): Thanks all — we'll close this thread after Tues rehearsal unless anything urgent pops up.
